physical_segment_dispositions.original_segment: Ural mountain crest north of the measured river reach
physical_segment_dispositions.original_reason: Pinned river geometry does not represent a mountain watershed. No invented straight longitude or modern country boundary is accepted.
physical_segment_dispositions.current_convention: Frozen named source-administrative Ural envelopes plus measured whole-location Ural-river majorities. Administrative reference lines are permitted; the current partition does not assert an unsurveyed mountain crest.
physical_segment_dispositions.physical_precision_disposition: The crest alternative remains unsurveyed. River geometry cannot resolve the higher-latitude mountain segment. No physical claim is promoted to verified.
physical_segment_dispositions.quantitative_crosscheck: All 532 current Ural candidates were independently measured: 489 show a conditional strict majority and all match current assignments; 43 lack sufficient river-reach coverage.

physical_segment_dispositions.original_reason: Source narratives establish a convention, but exact licensed crest geometry has not been verified; Russian, Georgian and Azerbaijani memberships require an independent whole-location majority.
physical_segment_dispositions.current_convention: Kuma–Manych-associated North Caucasus administrative reporting seam, rather than the older Greater Caucasus crest proposal.
physical_segment_dispositions.physical_precision_disposition: The archived crest proposal was superseded by the permitted administrative convention. Exact depression alignment remains unverified; no surveyed accuracy is claimed.

physical_segment_dispositions.original_reason: Mainland continent association is documented; exact watershed alignment must be measured against crossing local territories before physical boundary closure.
physical_segment_dispositions.current_convention: One identical pinned Panama–Colombia reference frontier for both North and South America, rather than independently estimated Darien watersheds.
physical_segment_dispositions.physical_precision_disposition: The archived watershed alternative was superseded by the accepted administrative reporting frontier. No exact watershed claim is made.

physical_segment_dispositions.original_reason: Competing geological, archipelago and conventional associations exist. Existing European/Asian assignments are retained as explicit reference exceptions pending exhaustive named-island crosswalk.
physical_segment_dispositions.current_convention: 19 named eastern-Aegean Greek island associations route to Anatolia and Eastern Mediterranean irrespective of Greek ownership. Cyprus is a separate named Asian association. Imbros/Bozcaada use explicit reference groups rather than a sovereignty rule.
physical_segment_dispositions.physical_precision_disposition: Named routing is complete for the current reference entries. Full shoreline and offshore-islet coverage is addressed by the separate global named-land audit. No tectonic or continental-shelf claim is made.
